context.title: Swing Left — November 3, 2026 California general election endorsements (California picks only)

subject.title: US House of Representatives, California District 6

positions.statement: Must-Flip Races: "CA-06 ... D - Challenger: Dr. Richard Pan" — "California’s Proposition 50 created a new Democratic leaning 6th District seat outside Sacramento. After leaving the Republican Party and running as an independent, U.S. Representative Kevin Kiley decided to run in this district. His opponent is Dr. Richard Pan, a former member of the California State Assembly. Despite the fact that Vice President Kamala Harris won the district by 8% in 2024, Kiley has a significant fundraising advantage and is strongly contesting this seat, trying to distance himself from national Republicans. Dr. Pan needs support to educate voters about Kiley’s real record and flip this seat blue."

subject.title: US House of Representatives, California District 22

positions.statement: Must-Flip Races: "CA-22 ... D - Challenger: Randy Villegas" — "This majority-Latino Central Valley seat is a top Democratic flip target after redistricting made it more competitive. Rep. David Valadao cast the deciding vote for the Republican budget bill that cuts an estimated $1 trillion from Medicaid over a decade, betraying nearly two-thirds of his constituents who rely on Medi-Cal. Randy Villegas, a local school board member, is offering voters a strong contrast."

subject.title: US House of Representatives, California District 48

positions.statement: Must-Flip Races: "CA-48 ... D - Open Seat: Marni von Wilpert" — "This San Diego-to-Palm Springs district became an open-seat opportunity after Republican Rep. Darrell Issa announced his retirement just ahead of the filing deadline. This district narrowly voted for Harris in 2024 and San Diego City Councilor Marni von Wilpert is strongly positioned to flip this seat."

subject.title: US House of Representatives, California District 13

positions.statement: Must-Hold Races: "CA-13 D - Incumbent: Adam Gray" — "Rep. Adam Gray holds a Central Valley seat, and he's one of the Democrats proving the party can compete and win in California's agricultural heartland. Holding this seat is key to Democrats keeping the path to a House majority intact."

subject.title: US House of Representatives, California District 45

positions.statement: Must-Hold Races: "CA-45 D - Incumbent: Derek Tran" — "Rep. Derek Tran flipped this Orange County seat in 2024 and is a top target for Republicans looking to claw it back. His re-election would cement Democratic gains in Southern California's changing suburbs, and he has proven to be a strong fundraiser."
